topic: Reviewing Japan traffic time zone discrepancies
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on analyzing traffic data for a specific facility in Japan (LBAD000651-00001). [p3] noted that the observed traffic values showed unusually high numbers during nighttime hours and average figures during peak times, suggesting potential time zone discrepancies. The conversation confirmed that the timestamps are received as Unix integers, which are stored in UTC. To resolve the discrepancy, it was suggested that someone check the clock settings on the sensors/routers at the facility.
decisions: The traffic data analysis needs to account for proper time zone conversion (UTC vs. local Japan time).
action_items: [p3] will contact the relevant team to check the clock settings on the sensors/routers.
